```python
from pocket_coffea.cuts.triggers import trigger_cut
from pocket_coffea.cuts.object_multiplicity import nJets
from pocket_coffea.cuts.btag import nBtagged

# Skim cuts: HLT trigger selection for semileptonic dataset
skim_cuts = [
    trigger_cut("semileptonic")
]

# Preselection cuts: object multiplicity and b-tag requirements
preselection_cuts = [
    nJets(
        collection="JetGood",
        min_n=4,
        pt_threshold=30
    ),
    nBtagged(
        min_n=2
    )
]

# Combined cut configuration
cuts_config = {
    "skim": skim_cuts,
    "preselection": preselection_cuts
}
```
